[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/23 (Tue) 14:04  
[USER] User wants a healthy breakfast option.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggestion for a healthy breakfast: oatmeal with fruit.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Recipe for oatmeal with fruit:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ingredients for oatmeal:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 1/2 cup rolled oats  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 1 cup water or milk (cow's milk or plant-based milk like almond or soy milk)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 1/2 banana, sliced  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Handful of berries (such as blueberries, strawberries, or raspberries)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions for oatmeal:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. In a pot, bring the water or milk to a boil.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Add the rolled oats and reduce the heat to a simmer.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Cook for 5-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the oats have absorbed most of the liquid and have a creamy consistency.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Transfer the oatmeal to a bowl.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Top the oatmeal with the sliced banana and berries.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Oatmeal is high in fiber, protein, and vitamins.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Oats provide sustained energy throughout the morning.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Fruit adds natural sweetness and a boost of antioxidants.
